svg.title: B3 — Bookmark confirmation and unavailable-audio alternatives
svg.desc: Separate proposed dialog excerpts for deleting a bookmark, switching books at a bookmark and missing local audio. Initial confirmation choice is non-destructive; cancel never changes current audio.
svg.text: B3 CONFIRMATIONS / UNAVAILABLE AUDIO
Alternative centered-dialog excerpts, not a multi-pane terminal layout
Delete bookmark — Rivers?
00:20:10 · Ferrykeeper's warning
Deletes only this note, not audio or progress.
Failure keeps the note and shows a retryable error.
> [Keep bookmark] [Delete bookmark]
Switch to Rivers at 00:20:10?
Current audio: Orchard · this will change books.
Save Orchard checkpoint before switching.
Cancellation leaves current audio untouched.
> [Stay with Orchard] [Switch and play]
Local audio unavailable — Rivers
The bookmark remains saved at 00:20:10.
Queue a download; do not seek Orchard.
No autoplay or auto-jump when download finishes.
> [Back to bookmarks] [Queue download]
Same-book jump / explicit seeks
Seek the stored absolute jump position once.
Preserve playing/paused state for current book.
No second smart rewind or repeated pre-roll.
Cross-book switch uses saved speed for target.
Modal / failure recovery
Dialogs own keys; Tab selects buttons, Enter activates the focused choice, Esc cancels and restores parent focus.
Save/delete/jump failures retain draft or bookmark and a truthful error; do not claim success or guaranteed rollback.
If playback changes behind a manager/editor, its book and pending action remain fixed. Never act on a different row.
